children: Emkay Global Financial' research report on Pine Labs

Pine Labs’ reported revenue was 2.4% above consensus, with both IAP (+30.9% yoy) and DITP (+20.8% yoy) contributing. While CM expanded by 54bps qoq to 72.8%, indirect costs climbed to Rs4.3bn from Rs4.0bn in 1Q as the company invested in marketing and platform, and are likely to increase on further investments. Adj EBITDA increased to Rs1.61bn from Rs1.32bn in 1QFY27, due to higher revenue, despite higher costs. Management disclosed monthly UPI GTV of ~Rs200bn (68% two-year CAGR), with 65% of it above Rs2,000, and it is targeting Rs330–340bn by FY28.

However, unlike Paytm, there is no quantification of the revenue uplift. As we incorporate UPI MDR and higher indirect costs, our FY28E/FY29E EBITDA rises 7.6%/6.3%. Our earlier TP of Rs230 constituted discounted value of the UPI MDR revenue and core business separately. We now incorporate UPI MDR in the core business and adjust for higher cost and capex ramp-up. Thus, our TP drops by ~4% to Rs220. Risk-reward remains favorable at 16.9x FY28E EV/EBITDA; we retain BUY.
